description: Mint a new, revocable link for a deck, flyer, page, t-shirt or brochure. Ungated by default (gateMode omitted or "none") — anyone with the link sees the whole thing, same as today's "anyone with the link" sharing. Pass gateMode:"allowlist" with allowedEmails to require a Lorem sign-in matching one of those addresses; add visibleUntil to make everything up to that point public and gate only the rest (deck/page/brochure only — a flyer or t-shirt has one surface, all-or-gated); add blurGated to redact the gated part as blurred pixels rather than withholding it outright; add exportEnabled to let a granted viewer download through the link itself; add notifyRecipients to email the allowlist. A target can carry several live links at once with different configs — this always mints a fresh token, never reuses one. Returns the token and the viewer URL; list_shares/update_share/revoke_share manage it afterward.

allowedEmails.description: Emails granted when gateMode is "allowlist". Matched case-insensitively against the signed-in account.

blurGated.description: Redact the gated part as blurred rasters (rendered server-side) instead of withholding it outright.

exportEnabled.description: Let a viewer export the visible part through the share link itself.

gateMode.description: "none" = anyone with the link (the default); "allowlist" = a Lorem sign-in matching allowedEmails

id.description: The deck id (list_decks) or artifact id (list_artifacts) being shared

notifyRecipients.description: Email each NEWLY added allowlist address an invite with the link. Needs a mail transport configured on the server (RESEND_API_KEY or SMTP_URL) — otherwise the config still saves, with a note that no mail went out.

visibleUntil.description: The visibility point for an allowlist gate: slide/panel/section index (1-based) public before the gate, rest hidden behind it. Omit or null for a title-only teaser. No meaning for flyer/tshirt (one surface).

name: create_share
title: Create a share link
